purpose: Preserve the V6 SMA-Q1 corpus while correcting the OpenHands evaluator defects established by raw V6 and response-lane evidence.

supersession.preservation: V6 and all prior artifacts remain immutable; no prior scenario or repetition is credited to V7.

unchangedBase.bindingPriorAmendments: All accepted V3 through V6 scientific, fixture, telemetry, and artifact-contract requirements remain binding unless explicitly superseded below.

rootCauseEvidence.v6Terminal: OpenHands reached maximum iterations 3 during the third repetition of SMAQ1N-002; the deleted conversation did not retain the causal action sequence.
rootCauseEvidence.v1OracleDefect: The response-lane and inherited Step 15 evaluators waited only for agent MessageEvent despite OpenHands supporting both FinishAction and MessageEvent terminal responses.
rootCauseEvidence.v2ObservedVariance: With the terminal oracle corrected, 59 conversations passed and conversation 60 completed normally but returned a non-exact 271-character MessageEvent.
rootCauseEvidence.causalLimit: The exact V6 maximum-iteration action sequence and the exact V2 divergent response body were deleted by their runners; their content remains unverified.

acceptedForms: agent ActionEvent with tool_name=finish and FinishAction.message

retainedFields: event ID, kind, source, and tool name

executionPolicy.resultRule: Only a complete 18-scenario, 96-repetition run may produce SMA-Q1 PASS or FAIL; incomplete execution is INCONCLUSIVE.

operatorDecision.instruction: Find the root cause and fix it completely.
